summary: Built schedule management interface with table view, filtering, pagination, bulk editing, and delete functionality. Created schedule-filters.jsx (status/channel/date range filters), schedule-table.jsx (table with checkboxes, columns for id/template/channel/scheduled_at/status/recipients/actions), bulk-edit-modal.jsx (reschedule selected schedules with future-date validation and confirmation), and schedule-list.jsx (parent orchestrator with pagination at 20/page, filter state, selection state, delete confirmation modal). Added bulkUpdateSchedules to frontend schedule-service.js. Integrated as new 'manage' tab in App.jsx.
